page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 64 vCPU dedicated AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance type includes zero local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistent data access and system OS volumes. Network throughput is rated at a baseline of 16 Gbps to support data transfers to external volumes and networked services. The absence of integrated GPUs or attached local disks optimizes resource allocation strictly toward CPU-bound compute capacity and system RAM.

With a vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1:2, the hardware profile offers resource density tailored for computational workloads that do not require extensive memory capacity per thread. The dedicated allocation of 64 processing cores provides predictable execution without resource contention from multi-tenant CPU sharing. Suitable workload fits include high-performance compute jobs, batch processing, CI/CD compilation pipelines, web server fleets, and CPU-based video encoding tasks.
